# Medium Visual draw.io Designer Skill

## Purpose

Create professional diagrams for Medium articles using draw.io / diagrams.net format.

## When to use

Use when the article needs:

- hero image
- concept diagram
- architecture diagram
- comparison diagram
- memory/block diagram
- metric dashboard
- visual checklist

## Design rules

- Every visual explains one idea.
- Avoid decorative images.
- Use consistent colors, fonts, spacing, and icons.
- Keep labels short.
- Use captions and alt text.
- Use 1200px width minimum.
- Export as PNG at 2x scale or SVG.

## Preferred style

- Light neutral background
- Rounded rectangles
- Clean arrows
- Primary colors: blue, indigo, slate
- Warning/cost colors: amber/red
- Success colors: green
- Font: Inter, Arial, or Helvetica

## Visual brief format

```markdown
# Visual Brief

Figure number:
Article section:
Purpose:
Core idea:
Diagram type:
Nodes:
Edges:
Color palette:
Caption:
Alt text:
Credit:
```

## Output

Create editable `.drawio` and `.xml` files under:

```text
medium/visuals/drawio/
```
